question: Within a fixed 128-configuration existing public-state controller family, does the exact candidate naturally retain source-specific Hand activation, inactive support and real-economy reachability? If not, stop this route to certification without another demonstration.

cohort.policy_definition: cohort.py policies(): actual parameter vectors and route preference, not one policy repeated on 128 seeds. All scalar ranges and order fixed in that source. No learned/refitted component.
cohort.crn: Every configuration within the stage receives all four seeds; configurations are correlated alternatives, not independent people. Report realized trajectory classes.

stages.inputs: First two frozen parameter configurations, vows 0/5, seed58080010, observer native/off and enabled factual logging; eight endpoints total.
stages.criterion: Complete full-endpoint identity except new bookkeeping fields; source-bound full trace/counterfactual/readout validity. No population sample.
stages.failure: No support rows until genuine delivery fault repaired under unchanged criteria; keep failed capture.

stages.criterion: All 128 configurations x four seeds complete, then evaluate the fixed necessary support gates.

stages.entry: Only V5 necessary-support PASS; same policies and seeds, V0.

activation.row: Final-deck Phantom and Preparation or Surge; positive realized above-reserve consumer HP marginal; and either positive exact source-all-off x consumer-high-off HP interaction on complete legal fixed prefixes, or source removal makes that recorded command prefix unavailable.
activation.policy: At least one of four rows active. The fixed-script opportunity witness is not counterfactual reoptimization or a complete mechanistic admission.
activation.inactive: None of the four rows records positive above-reserve Phantom health contribution from ANY supplier. A positive unclassified/other-supplier path is ambiguous, not inactive.
activation.reachable: At least one row contains final-deck Phantom plus Preparation/Surge and an actual consumer play.

gates.provenance: Support count scale and one-of-four policy aggregation from post-v38-package-order-heldout-v1 and post-v38-hand-size-inventory-v1/v2, archive c802be36510273481b6d0f865b92fac43abf6aff. This new necessary screen does not replace their independent full admission obligations.

fixed_counterfactuals: All eight masks0..7 of previously gated hand_rules, complete native prefixes from the first historical supplier in combat. Record each earliest unavailable command as blocked; subsequent payoff is UNKNOWN, never zero. Also matched direct Phantom mask0/4 for every consumer, including alternate suppliers.
observables: Full reflected state/queue, exact commands, UID, events, outcomes, natural offers/picks/final deck and all counterfactual traces. No selected successful-example subset.

operational_containment.action_turn_caps: Existing parent controller100 actions per turn/30turn combat unchanged.
operational_containment.publication: One coordinator commits closed chunks and reads their exact bytes from an empty Git checkout; no model per row and no archival-service dependency.

decision.pass: Necessary natural-support gate passes in this fixed family only; no package count increases. Continue the separately frozen missing independent complementarity, policy/peer separation, exact signed controls and guardrail confirmation.
decision.fail: Any complete-stage necessary gate fails: close this fixed Hand/controller support candidate and skip later stage. No automatic retune, more seeds, copied historical admission or label rescue. Preserve all partial mechanism results.
decision.inconclusive: Incomplete coverage or observer/source/binding/cap failure: no support judgment and no promotion. Fix delivery faults only under unchanged scientific inputs; never reset a valid scientific negative.

forbidden: No v25, old1024/2048/672 or prior Hand1032 preflight replay for new samples
No weakened signed RandomBuild replacement; balanced research is not arm2
No E0/E1 reopening or NodeO verdict rewrite
No package/detector/P9/release claim from this gate
limits: Existing public-controller family competence and sampling breadth are limited; passing these necessary predicates is not sufficient strategic diversity.
Only preparation/surge producer removal is tested; alternative suppliers remain in factual traces and cannot be falsely classed inactive.
Shared seeds and counterfactual clones are not independent new trials.
Vow5ceiling, C2, duration, relative performance, peer separation and independent complementarity are not proved by support counts.
